game.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved
game.blurb: First-person shooter, a remake of the campaign of Halo: Combat Evolved (2001), from 343 Industries, released 2026-07-28. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes and the mission names they give.

chapters.title: Pillar of Autumn to Truth and Reconciliation

chapters.title: Silent Cartographer to The Library
chapters.summary: Silent Cartographer, Assault on the Control Room, 343 Guilty Spark and The Library, with their mission challenges.

chapters.title: Two Betrayals, Keyes and The Maw

chapters.title: Boarding Action, The Most Dangerous Game and Heavy Burden

chapters.title: Combat Feats and Completion
chapters.summary: Grunt backpacks, Hunter backplates, hijacks, Flood parts, vehicle parts, headshots and every achievement.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Remake: RAWG's first result was the 2001 "halo-combat-evolved" (id 28448), so rawgDetail was replaced with "halo-campaign-evolved" (id 1013132, released 2026-07-28, 343 Industries per RAWG's developer list, published by Xbox Game Studios; RAWG's description names Halo Studios as the developer). The remake's own Steam app is used: the Steam schema calls app 2806050 "Project Meteorite" (an internal codename); the store list confirms it as "Halo: Campaign Evolved". StrategyWiki has a page "Halo: Campaign Evolved" at completion stage 0 (a stub); its only written subpage is "Table of Contents", which just transcludes the Halo: Combat Evolved table of contents. It links "/Walkthrough", "/Boarding Action", "/The Most Dangerous Game", "/Heavy Burden", "/Skulls", "/Weapons" and other subpages under its own name, none written, and links the other missions to Halo: Combat Evolved pages; nothing was used from it beyond that page-name split, which is why those three missions get their own chapter. Their place in the story order is not known (their unlock rates of 43, 40 and 36% sit between Keyes at 45% and just below The Maw at 37%). halo.fandom.com answers the API under "Halo: Campaign Evolved", with about 43 linked pages, mostly other Halo games; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Only 1 of 58 Steam achievements is hidden ("Food Critic", 8.6%); it sits in the first mission chapter as a placeholder. Mission challenges (for example "Map Quest", "Clean Lap") sit in their mission's chapter.
